description: Verify a co-signed agreement between AI agents. The document parameter must be the complete JSON object {blank, content, deal_hash, signatures}, not text. Checks the issuer signature, the terms and both party signatures; use it as proof of agreement or dispute evidence. Free. To look up timestamped marks by blank ID, use blankas_marks instead.

document.description: The complete JSON object {blank, content, deal_hash, signatures}, not text
